items.markdown:
To save a ChatGPT conversation as a PDF, you can `use built-in browser options, dedicated tools, or online converters`.

### 1. Browser "Print to PDF" (Built-in & Free)

This is the fastest method without installing anything:

1. Open your ChatGPT conversation in your browser.
2. Press **Ctrl + P** (Windows) or **Cmd + P** (Mac), or click the three dots in the conversation and select **Print**.
3. In the print menu, change the destination/printer to **Save as PDF**.
4. Adjust your layout or background settings if needed, then click **Save**.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF16f5FE7hftkCfjQV6HlIISPhG4pDW4Sf_7qDgfQP15dfIdwkIJCRgTfpCu6WwD_vqQtyNr1kzpG_YHxIoJLrf7zErlCxF09fZEWPEThiWLQkClMVauL7Cv1gbnEzNRHtFNMFkStPxnrv2DZV4uL4sshB0BBCuxhQfs1SSRQqhYETvbyHX9PyI9RMJWeRP3--xNJ2jGJu)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QqHLOgX8H54&vl=en)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rCVXWIthDc&vl=en-US&t=9)

### 2. Browser Extensions (Best for Complex Formatting)

If your chat has code blocks, math equations (LaTeX), or tables that break during a standard print, use a dedicated extension:

- **Chrome:** Install the [ChatGPT to Word or PDF Chrome Extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-to-word-or-pdf/mjdmggegbkookpcmbdllcnbfboikcbop?hl=en) to export chats with one click while preserving tables, code, and images.
- **Firefox:** Install [ChatGPT to PDF - Export ChatGPT chats to PDF, MD](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF11HMaiyMgdR4iN2EDTMLBBmERJFi1_nvTwV7qTFrNXaL4tSlELx7yp6o_jSOE3KfqY00_nPJJ_uZnNrY0u5lthvamR82NEsp-Ou87-91caCEzQW_Q3DrXQVBOLiy0rR-EoK_btK9cYUmeEQm8vsQtAJCQLIEvXwaF1731xryfhwXgBGb0fY) for local, one-click archiving.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF11HMaiyMgdR4iN2EDTMLBBmERJFi1_nvTwV7qTFrNXaL4tSlELx7yp6o_jSOE3KfqY00_nPJJ_uZnNrY0u5lthvamR82NEsp-Ou87-91caCEzQW_Q3DrXQVBOLiy0rR-EoK_btK9cYUmeEQm8vsQtAJCQLIEvXwaF1731xryfhwXgBGb0fY)[[2]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-to-word-or-pdf/mjdmggegbkookpcmbdllcnbfboikcbop)

### 3. Online Link Converter

- **GPTtoPDF:** Copy your public share link from ChatGPT and paste it into [GPTtoPDF](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHEIkXXmoHloun02XkqF1ts5a_P0JMql6JXVP-KYPVzxEfsaTXe3y85kud395vmXIkfD1dKzoyFk42vQqXYJ2_CTUDF-demy7HcZJ0-cgbFjh6F3Qz38A) to generate a clean PDF.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHEIkXXmoHloun02XkqF1ts5a_P0JMql6JXVP-KYPVzxEfsaTXe3y85kud395vmXIkfD1dKzoyFk42vQqXYJ2_CTUDF-demy7HcZJ0-cgbFjh6F3Qz38A)
